title: Opening, closing and duplicating in Music and Classes never acts on a stale or hidden request
acceptance: openPlaylist ignores a late reply for a playlist no longer shown and clears the songs on Back, so Start class never creates class B with A's songs (lane-B repro passes).
Duplicate runs through useAsyncAction: it shows pending state and an error message, and a repeat tap does not make a second copy (lane-B repro passes).
Closing the playlist or likes dialog during Creating skips navigation into the new class and shows a toast, as the owner confirmed in batch #805 and carried into #808.
TrackPreview Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record and catches failures; a new test covers the return record. The e2e smoke is unchanged.

Draft head d69c0f62fc241fe4ab9970d3b391f5be85a7b8fb had green GitHub CI. Claude’s verifier and acceptance audit reported all four acceptance lines met in their test environments, with real provider sign-in outstanding. The verifier measured 179,976 of 180,000 gzip bytes. Claude’s final review and audit reported three unresolved walk-away findings: (1) Recents can show a stale “No tracks” label beside a fresh count and duration and keep Preview disabled until Classes reopens; (2) leaving and returning with browser Back during the silent reload can restore pre-import songs; (3) a failed reload while the class is opening can leave “Loading class” until details are refreshed. These final findings came from the Nov 27 session; the draft description still describes round two.
